snapshot: Anthropic-SpaceX compute consolidation locks AI infrastructure into vertically integrated systems, compressing arbitrage windows for distributed competitors and establishing a managed duopoly favoring first-movers with capital access.

Bifurcated capital allocation emerges: mega-cap tech commands billion-dollar rounds on narrative while allocators rotate toward Asia private credit and tokenized RWAs seeking de-risked yield amid recession warnings.

US-China tech decoupling and labor organizing around military AI eliminate traditional margin cushions, forcing re-rating of industrial and financial services names while energy supply disruptions collide with equity valuations priced for growth.
themes: Capital rotation toward alternative assets and Asia
Geopolitical bifurcation and supply chain fragmentation
Labor organizing constraining defense tech compliance
Stagflationary compression of consumer discretionary demand
